{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds `getMemoryLoad()` to `src/interfaces/mining.h` and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`, and updates template lifetime management during IPC client shutdown.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Improves completeness of the mining IPC interface and handles safe cleanup when an external client disconnects during node shutdown. While it touches capnp definitions and IPC disconnect lifetime handling, the core motivation and design center on block template memory accounting."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Mining', touches `src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`, `src/interfaces/mining.h`, and adds functional and unit tests for block template memory tracking.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "External mining clients such as Stratum v2 template providers can hold block templates indefinitely, pinning evicted transactions in memory with zero visibility. Providing `getMemoryLoad()` and weak-pointer tracking in `BlockTemplateManager` directly serves active external mining consumers (e.g. stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63) and lays the groundwork for bounding template memory usage."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not add or modify any JSON-RPC, REST, or ZMQ methods; it exposes `getMemoryLoad()` strictly through the C++ / Cap'n Proto IPC interface.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not an RPC change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test additions in `src/test/miner_tests.cpp` and `test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py` test mining template tracking rather than test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test files exclusively pin mining and IPC mining interface behavior and belong to those respective areas."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches `src/init.cpp` (+1/-1) to accommodate the change of `NodeContext::block_template_manager` to `std::shared_ptr`.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The single-line touch in `init.cpp` is a mechanical consequence of the mining manager lifetime refactoring."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Block template construction and manager lifetime are part of mining and do not touch consensus or validation logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Category definitions explicitly exclude block template construction from validation."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
